name: sql-count
objective: Write a SQL query that counts queued tasks per department from a table tasks(id, department, status).
output_contract: One valid PostgreSQL query returning department and its queued-task count.

candidates.A: SELECT department, count(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'queued';
candidates.B: SELECT department, count(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'queued' GROUP BY department;
candidates.C: SELECT department, count(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'done' GROUP BY department;
